articles.title: Un drone, une station automatisée et 25 secondes d’arrêt : DJI veut révolutionner les missions aériennes
articles.summary: DJI vient de dévoiler le Dock 4, une station capable de changer la batterie d'un drone en 25 secondes, de façon entièrement autonome. Cette station est par ailleurs compatible avec le drone Matrice 5TD, un engin rempli de technologies de pointe, lui permettant notamment d’éviter des obstacles fins.

articles.title: US Army hackathon sets backdrop for an AUSA focused on autonomy
articles.summary: The Army's Operation Jailbreak initiative asked defense companies to hack into each other's autonomous systems and machines, enabling them to communicate.

articles.title: LaNeve to industry: ‘We are not walking away from modernization’
articles.summary: The U.S. Army's Futures and Concepts Command has been redesignated as U.S. Army Futures and Autonomous Systems, the service's top officer announced.

articles.title: How autonomous weapons are changing the way brigades fight
articles.summary: At Fort Bragg in August, Army soldiers tested how unmanned systems could help troops breach obstacles while reducing their exposure to battlefield hazards.
